description: Life insurance income-statement skeleton for SIC 6311 retaining all 74 supplied unique US GAAP concepts once. The supplied MetLife reference guides broad presentation; measurement, attribution and overlapping disclosures remain distinct. Hierarchy prescribes no arithmetic.
classification_notes: All 74 supplied concepts appear once; industry inventory coverage does not imply that a single issuer uses all concepts.

The reference guides broad presentation, not taxonomy equivalence, source-fact signs or issuer-reported arithmetic. No operating-income or other analytical concept is invented where none was supplied.
Groups and total nodes do not prescribe addition. Aggregate and detail, alternative measurements, attribution and expense classification axes can overlap.
Net investment income already deducts investment expense and excludes realized investment gains; do not deduct investment expenses again.
Gross and net policyholder benefits differ by assumed and ceded effects. Net amounts must not be adjusted for reinsurance a second time.
Market risk benefit earnings exclude instrument-specific credit risk. The supplied OCI concept represents its tax effect only.
DAC and VOBA amortization may be included in combined acquisition-cost or administrative expense totals. DAC disposals and expected-benefit other changes remain supplementary movements.
Consolidated, parent and noncontrolling results retain distinct scopes; preferred and other common-income adjustments are applied only to the appropriate numerator.
Written premiums are volume disclosures rather than substitutes for earned premiums; geographic pretax and current tax measures are subsets.
Review reasons identify concept-specific unresolved scope or presentation. Proposed mappings still require issuer-specific period, unit, dimension and source-fact checks.

metadata_contract.period_type: Verified against official US GAAP 2026 periodType for every concept. Duration rollforwards remain disclosures, not inferred expenses.
metadata_contract.unit_type: Taxonomy monetary, per-share and shares item types; no conversion is implied.
metadata_contract.contra: False for income statement concepts. Expense, recovery, tax and gain/loss signs require source-fact and issuer-presentation context.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 74 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts, reconciled with the local SIC 6311 IS inventory.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

nodes.label: Revenue
nodes.classification_note: Reported revenue and its overlapping components require an issuer-specific reconciliation. Net investment income already deducts investment expenses; hierarchy does not establish addition.

children.label: Net premiums earned
children.classification_note: Earned premiums are after assumed and ceded effects; written premium disclosures are separately classified.

children.label: Investment income and expenses
children.classification_note: Net investment income excludes realized investment gains/losses and already deducts investment expense. The expense is retained as a disclosure, not an additional deduction from net income.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInvestmentExpense
concepts.review_reason: These costs are already deducted in NetInvestmentIncome; identify whether separately disclosed or embedded in another expense total before presenting them as an expense line.

children.label: Investment and derivative gains and losses
children.classification_note: The following measurement and instrument families overlap. Realized-only amounts must not be added to realized-and-unrealized totals; derivative gains may be included in an investment result.

children.label: Aggregate investment gains and losses
children.classification_note: These aggregate scopes are alternatives, not additive measures. Establish realized/unrealized coverage and the instrument population.

children.label: Realized and unrealized investment gains and losses

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: This aggregate includes unrealized as well as realized results; it is not equivalent to or additive with RealizedInvestmentGainsLosses.

children.label: Security and other investment disposal results
children.classification_note: Debt/equity and other-investment details can be included in broader realized investment gains. Asset-class labels alone do not prove disjoint populations.

children.label: Realized debt and equity security gains and losses

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesRealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: The debt-and-equity realized subtotal may include the separately mapped FV-NI equity sale results and is a subset of broader realized investment results.

children.label: Realized FV-NI equity security gains and losses

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Only realized sale results for FV-NI equity securities are covered; reconcile their inclusion in debt-and-equity and total investment gains.

children.label: Gains and losses on other investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: The issuer-specific other-investment population must be distinguished from debt/equity securities and reconciled to the broader investment result.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax
concepts.review_reason: Derivatives recognized in earnings can affect investment results or insurance-related results; confirm issuer presentation and exclude amounts already included in another selected line.

children.label: Fee and other revenue
children.classification_note: Insurance fee income, securities-service fees and other income may overlap. Commission revenue is distinct from commission expense.

children.label: Insurance commissions, fees and service income
Banking, advisory, brokerage and underwriting fees

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentBankingAdvisoryBrokerageAndUnderwritingFeesAndCommissions
concepts.review_reason: This tag describes securities and advisory service revenue, not insurance underwriting commission expense; verify its inclusion in insurance fees or other revenue.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherIncome
concepts.review_reason: The definition does not restrict this residual to operating insurance revenue; confirm the issuer location and exclusions before treating it as a revenue component.

nodes.label: Insurance benefits and expenses
nodes.classification_note: Insurance expense aggregates, benefit components and functional expense disclosures overlap. Interest and investment costs require scope reconciliation before inclusion.

children.label: Reported expense total alternatives
children.classification_note: BenefitsLossesAndExpenses is the insurance-specific aggregate. OperatingExpenses and CostsAndExpenses have different general scopes and must not be added to it.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingExpenses
concepts.review_reason: This recurring operating-cost total need not equal the insurance-specific benefits, losses and expenses aggregate; establish benefit and interest inclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses
concepts.review_reason: This broad total combines cost of sales and operating expenses; reconcile its insurance-benefit and financing-cost scope with BenefitsLossesAndExpenses.

children.label: Policyholder benefits, claims and reinsurance
children.classification_note: Gross benefits precede assumed/ceded effects, while net benefits incorporate those effects. Reinsurance recovery/expense must not be applied again to a net amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PolicyholderBenefitsAndClaimsIncurredGross
concepts.review_reason: This measure precedes both assumed and ceded policy effects; it is an alternative to net benefits, not an additional benefit category.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ReinsuranceCostsAndRecoveriesNet
concepts.review_reason: This recovery/expense reflects assumed and ceded policies; reconcile its sign and inclusion in net benefits before using it with a gross presentation.

children.label: Future policy benefit expense and remeasurement
children.classification_note: Period expense, remeasurement and the broader benefits aggregate can overlap. These duration expenses are distinct from balance-sheet reserves and reserve rollforward changes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsPeriodExpense
concepts.review_reason: This is expense or income from changes in the accrued policyholder obligation; determine its inclusion in policyholder benefit totals before separate presentation.

children.label: Future policy benefit remeasurement gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitRemeasurementGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Remeasurement arises from a revised benefit ratio applied as of contract issue; identify its inclusion in reported benefit expense and preserve the issuer gain/loss sign.

children.label: Market risk benefit results
children.classification_note: The earnings fair-value change excludes instrument-specific credit risk; the supplied OCI-related tax disclosure is held separately.

children.label: Market risk benefit fair-value gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitChangeInFairValueGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: This earnings measure excludes instrument-specific credit risk and can be included in policyholder benefit expense; reconcile its presentation before adding it to benefit totals.

children.label: Policyholder credited interest and dividends
children.classification_note: Credited account interest and policyholder dividends are insurance expenses. Credited interest must be reconciled with benefit totals and general interest expense.

children.label: Interest credited to policyholder account balances
Acquisition cost and acquired business amortization
children.classification_note: The combined DAC and future-profits amortization measure overlaps standalone DAC and acquired-business amortization; select a reconciled aggregate or components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresentValueOfFutureProfitsAmortization1
concepts.review_reason: The combined amortization includes DAC and acquired future profits; establish whether VOBA amortization is included before using standalone components.

children.label: Selling and administrative expenses
children.classification_note: SG&A, G&A, commission and natural expense disclosures can overlap; no hierarchy here establishes a functional expense sum.

children.label: Administrative expense totals
children.classification_note: G&A is narrower than SG&A. Residual G&A excludes separately identified G&A components only where supported by the issuer.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
concepts.review_reason: G&A can be contained in SG&A and is not an additional category alongside a selected SG&A total.

children.label: Commission expenses
children.classification_note: Insurance commissions and sales commissions may describe overlapping distribution costs. Fees earned from customers are classified in revenue.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SalesCommissionsAndFees
concepts.review_reason: Sales distribution costs can include insurance commission expense; identify the product and distribution scope before using both commission tags.

children.label: Personnel expenses
children.classification_note: LaborAndRelatedExpense already covers employee benefits and equity compensation; do not add the overlapping narrower disclosure to it.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Employee benefit and equity compensation expense is included in the broader labor definition; reconcile any separate presentation with LaborAndRelatedExpense.

children.label: Other administrative cost disclosures
children.classification_note: Lease and professional service costs may already be included in functional expense totals or personnel-related disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseExpense
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease cost excludes sublease income and may be embedded in G&A or another functional expense; use only a reconciled separate presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProfessionalFees
concepts.review_reason: The definition covers professional-service fees without a fixed insurance expense function; establish whether included in G&A, selling or other expenses.

children.label: Other expense disclosures
children.classification_note: Other operating expenses and general other expenses are potentially overlapping residual categories; only the former explicitly restricts scope to operations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherExpenses
concepts.review_reason: This residual expense tag does not specify operating classification and can overlap OtherCostAndExpenseOperating; verify location and exclusions.

nodes.label: Interest and other nonoperating results
nodes.classification_note: Interest classification and instrument detail are different axes. Operating and nonoperating interest must reconcile to total interest; debt interest can cross both.

children.label: Interest expense presentations
children.classification_note: Total interest includes operating and nonoperating expense. Debt interest is an instrument subset, not a third additive category; policyholder credited interest requires separate scope review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebt
concepts.review_reason: Debt interest can span operating and nonoperating classifications; reconcile this instrument-based disclosure to the selected interest presentation.

children.label: Gain or loss on disposal within continuing operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: This pretax disposal result explicitly excludes discontinued operations; verify its operating or nonoperating placement and inclusion in other income or expense.

nodes.label: Pretax income presentations
nodes.classification_note: Before-equity-method and after-equity-method pretax amounts have different scopes; domestic pretax income is a supplemental geographic subset.

children.label: Pretax continuing income before noncontrolling interests
Pretax continuing income before equity-method results

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesMinorityInterestAndIncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: This subtotal precedes addition of equity-method results, unlike the other supplied pretax continuing-income total; it cannot substitute without reconciliation.

nodes.label: Income tax expense and current components
nodes.classification_note: Continuing-operation total tax includes current and deferred effects. Current tax and its federal/national subset are nested components; no deferred tax amount is inferred.

children.label: Continuing-operation income tax expense or benefit
Current income tax components
children.classification_note: Current tax excludes deferred tax. Federal/national current tax is a subset, not an additional total tax line.

children.label: Current income tax expense or benefit
Current federal or national tax expense or benefit
children.classification_note: Includes current national income tax for non-US jurisdictions; not a US-only total.

nodes.label: Continuing and discontinued operation results
nodes.classification_note: Consolidated, parent-attributable and noncontrolling-interest results are distinct attribution scopes and must not be added without a matched reconciliation.

children.label: Continuing operation results
children.classification_note: The consolidated amount includes noncontrolling interests; the parent amount excludes them. Do not deduct noncontrolling interests from a parent-attributable result again.

children.label: Discontinued operation results
children.classification_note: These after-tax results differ by attribution; neither is a component to add to the other.

nodes.label: Net income and attribution
nodes.classification_note: ProfitLoss includes noncontrolling interests; NetIncomeLoss is parent-attributable. Noncontrolling income is an attribution disclosure, not an extra deduction from parent net income.

children.label: Net income attributable to noncontrolling interests

nodes.label: Common shareholder income and adjustments
nodes.classification_note: Preferred adjustments and basic/diluted common income use different scopes. Diluted common income can incorporate assumed issuances; no numerical reconciliation is prescribed.

children.label: Preferred dividends and other adjustments
children.classification_note: Preferred dividends are contained in the broader preferred-dividend-and-other-adjustment amount; do not deduct both.

children.label: Preferred dividends and other common-income adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: This aggregate includes adjustments beyond preferred dividends; reconcile participating-security and other allocations before substituting it for preferred dividends alone.

children.label: Income available to common shareholders - basic
Income available to common shareholders - diluted

nodes.label: Earnings per share
nodes.classification_note: Total and continuing-operation EPS are different result scopes. Basic and diluted EPS use different denominators; never add them.

children.label: Total earnings per share
children.classification_note: Select basic or diluted presentation without summing per-share measures.

children.label: Continuing-operation earnings per share
children.classification_note: Continuing-operation EPS can be included within total EPS and is retained as a separate scope.

nodes.label: Weighted-average shares
nodes.classification_note: These duration weighted averages are EPS denominators, not balance-sheet shares outstanding. Basic and diluted counts are alternatives.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Written premium volumes, geographic pretax subsets, balance rollforward changes and OCI tax effects are retained outside primary earnings categories.

children.label: Written premium disclosures
children.classification_note: Written and earned premiums use different recognition bases. Direct premiums precede assumed and ceded effects; ceded amounts alone cannot reconcile direct to net without assumed premiums.

children.label: Geographic pretax income
children.classification_note: Domestic pretax income is a geographic subset of continuing operations and must not be added to a consolidated pretax total.

children.label: Acquisition cost and reserve rollforward disclosures
children.classification_note: Disposals and liability rollforward changes are duration movements, not automatically current-period earnings expense.

children.label: DAC disposed or classified as held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsDisposition
concepts.review_reason: This measures DAC disposed or held for sale, not amortization expense; a separate earnings impact cannot be inferred from the asset movement.

children.label: Expected future policy benefits - other change

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFuturePolicyBenefitIncreaseDecreaseForOtherChange
concepts.review_reason: This is an other-change movement in the expected future benefit and expense component, not the period expense or benefit-ratio remeasurement result.

children.label: OCI tax disclosures
children.classification_note: This supplied concept is a tax effect of instrument-specific credit-risk changes, not the market risk benefit OCI gain/loss itself or continuing-operation income tax.

children.label: Tax on market risk benefit credit-risk OCI

concepts.name: us-gaap:OciMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificCreditRiskGainLossAfterAdjustmentsTax
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines tax expense or benefit after adjustments for instrument-specific credit-risk OCI; do not use it as an OCI gain/loss amount or earnings tax expense.
